title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
summary_lines: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.
